newsitem.title: USA: Frontier board oks merger partner search.
newsitem.headline: Frontier board oks merger partner search.

text.p: Frontier Natural Gas Corp said Monday its board authorized a search for a strategic merger candidate, and has hired investment bankers Gaines Berland Inc to assist in certain facets of this search.
The company said it is authorized to look for a partner that could complement its current project inventory and add financial strength.
The company reported a second quarter loss per share of $0.14 compared with a loss per share of $0.05 for the same period a year ago.

The company said $408,968 of its 1997 second quarter net loss of $1.3 million was related to exploration costs expensed in the quarter and $156,615 was a non-cash loss recognized which relates to future hedging obligations.
